helpText: Review commitments submitted by actors in your country. Link commitments that are ready to be published, or return them for revision.
helpAutoLinkPost: (Annex II, para. 3), commitments are published on a non-objection basis. If no action is taken within 4 weeks (28 days) of submission, the commitment is automatically linked.
helpStatusLinked: Reviewed and published by a focal point
helpStatusAutoLinked: Published automatically after 28 days or if auto-publishing enabled
helpStatusReturned: Sent back to the submitting actor for revision
returnToCountryDesc: The country will be asked to revise and resubmit this commitment.
